Administration
The Administrator’s Office provides support to Polk County departments and activities to ensure coordinated, efficient, and cost effective use of resources.
Attorney's Office
Learn about the role of the Attorney's Office and its Coordinated Victim Services.
Environmental Services
Polk County Environmental Services consists of the Planning and Zoning, Solid Waste Transfer Station, Recycling, and Household Hazardous Waste Departments.
Finance
View audits and budgets of Polk County operations over the past several years.
Public Health
Polk County Public Health’s mission is to promote health and wellness for residents through prevention, education, intervention, advocacy, and collaboration.
Public Works
The mission of the Polk County Public Works is to plan, develop, and maintain an environmentally sound infrastructure for all citizens of Polk County.
Sheriff's Office
It is the mission of the Polk County Sheriff's Office to provide a safe and secure environment for our citizens.
Social Services
Polk County Social Services is the county's public welfare and social services agency. It’s divided into child support, income maintenance, and social programs.
Taxpayer Service Center
The Taxpayer Service Center provides quality service and information to Polk County residents and taxpayers.
Veteran's Services
Polk County Veterans Services provides guidance and assistance to Veterans and their family members regarding federal and state Veteran benefit programs.
